archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-02.5 Register Standardized Artefacts
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Finally, once data is validated, it is registered and stored as a standardized artefact within the organization’s controlled repositories. Each dataset is given a version identifier, linked with its metadata, and catalogued for discovery and reuse. The registration process ensures traceability — it documents how the data was transformed, what standards were applied, and where it originated. This makes it possible to track lineage and maintain consistency across time and versions. At this point, the data is ready to move into the next phase: Data Editing & Enrichment — where its quality and completeness will be further refined.
Value created: Traceable, reusable, and standardized dataset ready for editing and analysis.
